description: JESJAW crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C72 H42 Cl9 Dy3 N8 O9,3(C6 H7 N1),H2 O1. From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 4 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.543-3.549 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 94.74-98.97°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy3(QCl)8Cl(OH2)]·3(2-methylpyridine)·H2O.
